scenario: Cycle rejection is a compile error per [LCYC.3.1] (LCYC.8.1, the id, is a tombstone) — no runtime cycle-breaking. A direct A → B → C → A cycle through emit + match is rejected at compile time with DS_VALIDATE_RULE_CYCLE.
rules_ds:
schema X scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Y scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Z scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule a:
    X
->
    emit Y logical v: 1

rule b:
    Y
->
    emit Z logical v: 1

rule c:
    Z
->
    emit X logical v: 1
